goldens.comment: logic: Potential nil pointer exception - if no TopicUser record exists, tu will be nil and calling methods on it will crash
goldens.reasoning: C1 identifies the same nil TopicUser crash.

goldens.comment: Typo in property name: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'n' in 'Notifications')

candidates: Null pointer dereference in the unsubscribe action of topics_controller.rb: TopicUser.find_by returns nil when no record exists, but tu.notification_level is called unconditionally, causing NoMethodError for users without a TopicUser record

Route path inconsistency between Ember client and Rails server: Ember route defines topicUnsubscribe with path /t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe using params.id, but Rails expects params[:topic_id], causing TopicView.new to receive nil
Unsubscribe link rendering conditional causes respond_instructions placeholder to not be replaced when add_unsubscribe_link is false, leaving raw %{respond_instructions} text in email body
